summary: Very short 3,700px index: a pale head with a photo of three staff, six role cards with an Explore link, a pink panel with eight further support areas and one centered form card. Almost no imagery after the head.

sections.note: pale blurred office ground; left: serif title, a short lead, one filled pill button; right: a cutout photo of three smiling staff standing together.
centered serif heading; six text cards (3 by 2) with a small purple title, two lines and an 'Explore >' link, no icons or images
pink-tinted band: centered serif heading; eight further offers in two columns, each a large serif title and a short paragraph, no links
a single centered white card with a heading, a line and a form (names, email, phone, company, country, consent)
